name: i9_10_topfloor_team_info_popup
note: Runs the stock NewRankWindow.clickCell callback for MID 291 (ARENA_RANK) and MID 295 (ARENA_MODE_RANK_INFO) and asserts the opened arena_team_info window recomputes client power from valid Hero identities. Eligibility is earned with real normal-rung STARTs (ten challenges, pending reports re-polled with the same parameters, no extra ticket). The mode defense is chosen from xyd.tables.arenaMode heroNum/banList/isLead and Hero:getFromType camps, so Camp and Ban rotations are honored. No pet is provisioned by the virtual client, so the optional-pet popup path is NOT_RUN here and is covered natively. The rank-list layout is not exercised: clickCell is invoked with the stock ranking row shape and the stock callback body opens arena_team_info.
steps: lua:local m=xyd.WindowManager.get() if m:getWindow('edit_player_name') then m:closeWindow('edit_player_name') end local w=m:getWindow('arena') assert(w and not w.isShowArenaMode,'vc-popup-arena-missing')

lua:local a=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.ARENA) local hs={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do table.insert(hs,h) if #hs>=5 then break end end a:saveArenaDefenderData({defenseHeroes=hs}) __vcNormalDefense=#hs

lua:__tfDone=0 __tfTickets=5 __tfLast=0 __tfPending=nil __tfRetries=0 function __tfStart(params) xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.START_FIGHT,params,function(code,body) if code~=xyd.error.OK then print('vc-tf-start-refused',body and body.error_code) return end if #body.battle_report==0 then __tfPending=params return end __tfPending=nil __tfRetries=0 __tfDone=__tfDone+1 __tfTickets=__tfTickets-1 local function reload() xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.LOAD_ARENA_PLAYER_LIST,{}) end xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_RESET_TIMER,{},function() if __tfTickets>0 then reload() return end xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_BUY_TICKET,{},function() __tfTickets=5 reload() end) end) end) end function __tfCycle() if __tfPending then __tfRetries=__tfRetries+1 if __tfRetries>10 then error('vc-tf-pending-report-timeout') end __tfStart(__tfPending) return end local a=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.ARENA) local ids={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do if #ids<5 then table.insert(ids,h:getHeroID()) end end local e=nil for _,c in ipairs(a:getEnemies()) do if c.table_id~=__tfLast then e=c end end __tfLast=e.table_id __tfStart({formation=table.concat(ids,'|'),enemy_id=e.table_id,is_avenge=0,campaign_type=xyd.CampaignType.ARENA}) end

lua:local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena') local a=w.arena_ assert(w.isShowArenaMode and a.modeType and a.modeType>0,'vc-task-not-admitted') local mode=a.modeType local slots=xyd.tables.arenaMode:heroNum(mode) local banned=xyd.tables.arenaMode:banList(mode) local bannedSet={} for _,id in ipairs(banned) do bannedSet[id]=true end local pool={} for _,h in pairs(xyd.selfPlayer:getHeros()) do local t=h:getFirstTableID() if not bannedSet[t] then table.insert(pool,h) end end assert(#pool>0,'vc-popup-mode-no-eligible-hero') local camp=0 if mode==xyd.ArenaModeType.CAMP then camp=a.subMode and a.subMode>0 and (a.subMode==10 and xyd.HeroFromType.QUN or a.subMode) or pool[1]:getFromType() end local chosen={} for _,h in ipairs(pool) do if #chosen<slots and (camp==0 or h:getFromType()==camp) then table.insert(chosen,h) end end assert(#chosen>0 and #chosen<=slots,'vc-popup-mode-roster-'..#chosen) local leader=xyd.tables.arenaMode:isLead(mode)==1 and chosen[1]:getHeroID() or 0 a:saveModeDefenderData({defenseHeroes=chosen,pet_id=0,leader_id=leader},function() __vcModeDefense=true end) __vcMode=camp

lua:function __vcPopup(tag) local w=xyd.WindowManager.get():getWindow('arena_team_info') assert(w and w.team,'vc-'..tag..'-no-window') assert(w.team.heroes and #w.team.heroes>0,'vc-'..tag..'-no-heroes') assert(type(w.team.force)=='number' and w.team.force>0,'vc-'..tag..'-power') assert(type(w.team.rank)=='number' and w.team.rank>0,'vc-'..tag..'-rank') for _,h in ipairs(w.team.heroes) do assert(h.getTableID and h:getTableID()>0,'vc-'..tag..'-hero-table') assert(h:getZhandouli()>0,'vc-'..tag..'-hero-power') end print('vc-popup-force',tag,w.team.force,#w.team.heroes) return w.team.force end __vcClick=import('app.windows.NewRankWindow').clickCell

lua:local rl=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.RANK_LIST) rl:delRankInfoByType(xyd.SubRankType.ARENA_RANK) rl:loadRankList({xyd.SubRankType.ARENA_RANK},true,function(code,reply) assert(code==xyd.error.OK,'vc-popup-rank-list') local info=reply.rank_list[1].rank_info assert(info and info.rank_info and #info.rank_info>0,'vc-popup-rank-empty') __vcRankRow=info.rank_info[1] end)

lua:local a=xyd.ModelManager.get():loadModel(xyd.ModelType.ARENA) local e=a.mEnemies[1] assert(e,'vc-popup-task-enemy') local target=e.table_id+xyd.selfPlayer.region*100000 xyd.Backend.get():request(xyd.mid.ARENA_MODE_QUERY_FORMATION,{other_player_id=target},function(code,reply) assert(code==xyd.error.OK,'vc-popup-295-query') assert(reply.is_robot==true,'vc-popup-295-not-robot') assert(reply.heros and #reply.heros>0,'vc-popup-295-query-heroes') __vcRobot=target __vcClick({curSubType=xyd.SubRankType.ARENA_MODE_RANK_INFO},{player_id=target},reply.rank or 0) end)
